message: 違う目的。同じ気持ち
Azel is the enemy? Azel is Re-Crea? I have to defeat Azel by my own hand?
It doesn't feel real. It all feels like some far-fetched fiction.
But if I don't, the world will be destroyed.
Still, defeating Azel by my own hand...
I can't do it. I have to do it. Do I really?
I don't want to think about it. I have to think about it. Isn't there some way out of this?
There's no time. This is our only chance. The world, Ryuusei Town, and the academy are all counting on what we do.
But, but, but.
My head just keeps spinning.
I understand the logic, but I can't accept it.

name: Paqy
message: 「Demon Lord. You oughta get a little sleep before heading to the academy.」

name: Synn
message: 「I can't sleep.」
I couldn't sleep a wink.

name: Paqy
message: 「Even so, going for a walk this early in the morning?」
A path I've walked with Azel countless times.
A tiny park that's always deserted.
It's just an ordinary park like any other you'd find lying around, yet.
The first photos Azel ever took with her Leica.
We couldn't wait until getting home, so we spread them out right here to look at them, didn't we.
Having memories of a place makes it start looking special.

name: Paqy
message: 「Soba and Azel used to go at it here all the time.」
Nanaka confessed to me, and I turned her down.
And I realized I'm in love with Azel.
That only happened a little while ago, yet somehow it feels like ages in the past.

name: Paqy
message: 「You were the only one who hadn't noticed, Synn-sama.」

name: Synn
message: 「Am I... dense?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Being a little dense is just right for a Demon Lord. Otherwise, the pressure of having the world on your shoulders would drive you crazy.」

name: Synn
message: 「There were others like that?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Plenty of 'em. There was even one guy who wrote off being the Demon Lord and yours truly's existence as total delusions, and shut himself up in his room.」

name: Synn
message: 「And the world turned out okay?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Re-Crea just happened to be small in scale that time.」

name: Synn
message: 「You know, Paqy. Do you actually remember quite a bit?」

name: Paqy
message: 「I-It was just a coincidence.」

name: Synn
message: 「What about Dad?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Even though he was super popular and could've had his pick, he was completely oblivious to the feelings of anyone other than your mother, Synn-sama.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see...」
A shopping street so early in the morning that not a single shop is open yet.
A shopping street I know inside and out.
A shopping street that will vanish without a trace if the world ends.
Five-Star Hanten, where I ate ramen with Azel.
Shina-oba's Shinagawa Greengrocer, which Azel photographed over and over.
Tame-san's Ponpoko, where he used to tease Azel and me.
The clothing store where Helena-san bought clothes for Azel.
The beef bowl shop where Eauderourke, who treated Azel and me to beef bowls, works.
The photo shop where Azel always went to get her photos developed.
No matter what I look at, it reminds me of Azel.
Still, if I don't defeat Azel, everything will disappear.
Still, even so...

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Morning. Prez.」

name: Synn
message: 「M-Morning.」
He really is out jogging...

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Sorry. Not yet. Shop not open. But, Prez, special. Now, beef bowl, I make.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, it's not like that...」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Little bit, wait.」
Eauderourke whipped up two beef bowls for us in no time at all.

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Done.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Looks delicious.」

name: Eauderourke
message: 「Morning, no eat. Strength, no come. Good ideas, no float up.」
He's trying to cheer me up.

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you.」

name: Paqy
message: 「So good!」
That night, Azel brought me to this park.
Did Azel team up with Soltia to trap me?
Maybe she did.
Just like Riesling said, it's all too convenient to be a coincidence.

name: Paqy
message: 「Synn-sama, it's gonna get cold.」

name: Synn
message: 「Sigh...」
I guess I have no choice but to accept it.
Azel teamed up with Soltia and led me into a trap.
She even tried to strangle me.
She was connected to Pasta, too, and was involved in creating the magic circle meant to destroy the world.
On top of that, she's taken the power of Re-Crea into her own body and is trying to destroy the world.
Still, if she wanted to lure me out, she could've just openly invited me for a walk--so why did she sneak back like that?
Why did she warn me about Soltia's surprise attack?
Why was she crying when she saw me beaten down by Soltia?
When I defeated Soltia, why did she just watch without doing anything?
And afterward, when she tried to strangle me, why did she stop halfway through?
In front of the church, too--why did she stop attacking the moment she realized it was us?
And when she vanished into that alternate space, why did she leave behind words that practically pointed out her own weakness?

name: Paqy
message: 「If you're not gonna eat it, I'm diggin' in.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Paqy. Were there any Demon Lords in the past who ended up in a situation like this?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Expecting that kind of knowledge out of yours truly? You're losing your touch, Demon Lord.」
Just like earlier, Paqy might actually remember everything.
Maybe he's avoiding spelling out the past or giving me the answers so he doesn't bind my free will.
Am I overthinking things?

name: Paqy
message: 「Though, hey, there's one thing I can tell you for sure.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Whatever decisions the past Demon Lords made, the world's still going, which means they weren't wrong. All's well that ends well.」

name: Synn
message: 「As my familiar, shouldn't you be advising me to defeat Azel?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Someone other than yours truly already beat me to that, so there's no point now.」
He must mean Helena and the others.

name: Paqy
message: 「Not like they enjoyed saying that stuff either, you know.」

name: Synn
message: 「I know it's not something I should hesitate over... in my head, at least.」

name: Synn
message: 「Defeating Azel to protect this world... I guess that's the only way... isn't it?」

name: Paqy
message: 「It's what Azel would call the rational choice.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah...」
If my opponent were Soltia or Bylous, I might not have hesitated.
I might have been roused by a sense of duty to protect the world.
But when it's Azel, it's completely different.

name: Synn
message: 「Why... did I end up falling for Azel...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Regretting it, Synn-sama? Well, that woman doesn't have any boobs, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I'm not! Not at all! But.」
I don't know. My chest hurts. I feel like I'm going to cry.
Suddenly.
Suddenly, I remembered.
Back then, Azel looked like she was about to burst into tears. Like she was going to break.

name: Azel
message: 「I was supposed to hate this world.」

name: Azel
message: 「I had to hate it!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's it!」
Azel ended up coming to love this world.
I'm sure of it--Ryuusei Town, the academy, everyone
Even though she had to hate it, even though she could destroy it without hesitation if she hated it, she came to love it instead.
That's why Azel was wavering. Always wavering. Just like I am right now.
Probably even right now, as we speak.
We're the same.
